The source digest above is the digest of the CURRENT docs/design/padel-friend.pen bytes at export time and is re-checked against the file by test/leagues.standings.visual-references.test.ts. Frame xbIxj depicts a T15 score correction (Community Admin amendment); PAF-12 intentionally adapts that composition to the truthful late-first-confirmation publication copy and never depicts an amendment, so only composition and tokens are compared. visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Capture the 390x844 viewport at Chromium deviceScaleFactor 1 (ywfn7 dark, xbIxj light, en). Downsample only the uncropped 2x Pencil PNG. Mask every block with a documented composition delta: the referenceMasks rects below (Pencil frame coordinates) plus the matching production blocks (page header, details card, each child of the standings section, every block after it), each with a 1px margin. Compare the remaining pixels with the same-size RGBA pinned perceptual threshold (35215 x 0.1^2); reject any dimension mismatch before applying the per-screen budget, and reject masks above maxMaskedFraction.
visualBudgets.reason: The budget covers only the unmasked raster (page background, gutters, shell). Content and composition deltas are never absorbed by it: they are masked, listed in compositionDeltas, and gated by exact structural probes. Budgets are the smallest two-decimal-or-better value above the measured scoped residual with at most 0.02 headroom.

perScreenRationale.ywfn7: Scoped to the unmasked 9.6% of the frame (background, gutters, bottom shell). Measured scoped residual 0 (full frame 0.19135 is informational only: it is dominated by the documented content/composition deltas listed in compositionDeltas.ywfn7). 0.005 is the minimum nonzero budget for renderer variance and stays within the 0.02 headroom rule.
perScreenRationale.xbIxj: Scoped to the unmasked 14.3% of the frame (background, gutters, bottom shell). Measured scoped residual 0.00463 (full frame 0.10728 is informational only: dominated by the documented deltas in compositionDeltas.xbIxj, notably the T15 correction card PAF-12 does not implement). 0.01 leaves 0.0054 for renderer variance.

d6ANDN.reason: The frame is a full-screen route; production adapts it to a Base UI alertdialog modal over the League page (scrim, dialog card, Cancel first so the safe action holds initial focus). A full-frame comparison therefore measures the page behind the scrim (0.8512 changed pixels), not the dialog; a budget that large would mask any defect, so no screenshot budget exists. The dialog is certified by the exact structural probes above instead.
